cells.name: Write the weekly project update
faces: Write the update the team reads on Monday

cells.name: Flag project dates at risk
faces: Compare committed dates against the plan
Name the ones that will slip

cells.name: Prepare the Monday leadership update
faces: Turn the weekly update into a deck leadership reads in ten minutes

findings.title: Three cells depend on one reading of the plan
findings.detail: The update, the risk flag and the leadership deck all read the same plan file, so a wrong plan is wrong in three places at once.
findings.action: Check the plan before the Monday run rather than after it.

findings.title: The leadership deck lags the update it summarises
findings.detail: It runs on average four hours later, so a late change reaches the team and not leadership.
findings.action: Run the deck from the update, not from the plan.

limits: Run history covers 90 days. Anything quarterly appears once or not at all.
Nothing inside a document is read; only what the cells declare.
